purpose: Teach: 過失/匹敵/八木/出血/究明/受診/遮断/一刻

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、メディアの過失報道、深く、論じていますね。
lines.en: Ren, your paper examines media negligence in reporting quite deeply, doesn't it.
lines.style: Measured, genuinely interested. Warm acknowledgment of careful work. Slight rising inflection at the end—opening the conversation, not closing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時の社会的影響、現代の事件に匹敵するものでした。
lines.en: Yes. The social impact of that era was equivalent to what we see in modern incidents.
lines.style: Quiet, precise. Speaking from thought-through conviction, not performance. A slight pause before answering, like he's choosing the right words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 八木義一郎の記事、当時、大きな反響、ありましたね。
lines.en: Yagi Giichiro's articles created quite a stir at the time, didn't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, drawing out the historical weight. Not lecturing—reflecting alongside him. Comfortable with the pause the topic deserves.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。被害者の出血シーン、無防備に、報道されていました。
lines.en: Yes. The victim's injuries were reported without any protective discretion whatsoever.
lines.style: Grave undertone. Slower pace on that phrase—the gravity settling in. Not angry, but the weight of carelessness is clear in his voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 真相究明、ジャーナリストの責任、扱っていますね、卒論。
lines.en: So your thesis addresses both the need for truth and the journalist's responsibility in getting there.
lines.style: Nodding in voice. She's recognizing the sophistication of what he's doing. Warm but steady—the kind of encouragement that respects his thinking rather than praising him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。証言者が、心療内科を受診した、というケースもありました。
lines.en: Yes. There were cases where witnesses needed psychiatric care afterward.
lines.style: Quiet but unflinching. He's stating a fact that matters, not dwelling on it. The restraint in his delivery makes it heavier.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 情報の遮断、検閲、戦時下、特に、厳しかったですね。
lines.en: Information control and censorship were especially strict during wartime, of course.
lines.style: Engaged but grounded. She's anchoring the historical context—not agreeing lightly, but acknowledging a difficult complexity. Even pace, steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。一刻も早く、報道倫理を、確立する必要、論じました。
lines.en: Yes. I argued that reporting ethics needed to be established as quickly as possible.
lines.style: The conviction solidifies here. Slight emphasis on 'needed'—he believes this matters beyond the thesis. Not rehearsed, but clearly held.
